notes.title: ASCENDARIA - Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
Here's a patch for the final version of the game, with a few bonus additions! Enjoy!

[b]🔥New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] The game is now fully playable with a controller!
[*] Original royalty-free music has been added, unique to each zone.
[/list]
[b]💠Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Jumpers in the “Fantasy” and “Space” worlds have been adjusted.
[*] The camera now recenters automatically on the credits after a few seconds.
[*] Outlines of some UI texts have been tweaked for better readability.
[*] Scanner eye icons now fade out progressively.
[*] Object rotations have been corrected for smoother visuals.
[*] The scanner is now mapped to the right joystick by default.
[/list]
[b]⚙️Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Spelling mistakes have been corrected throughout the game.
[*] The language switch to English now applies properly every time.
[*] Several menus now work correctly with controllers.
[*] Forgotten duplicate objects in the Fantasy and Space worlds have been removed.
[*] The back of the spikes in the “Studio” world are no longer transparent.
[*] Traps no longer push the player on the way back.
[*] Footstep sounds on grass now play the correct sound.
[/list]
I can't wait to read your feedback! Stay tuned for upcoming updates.
Join the community and share your thoughts: [url=https://bento.me/anotherslimestudio]Another Slime Studio[/url]

Thanks and see you soon! 🚀
Artékuro.

notes.title: ASCENDARIA - Update 1.0.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone, here’s the latest major update with the newest big additions!
The next patches will be mostly bug fixes, so you can now fully enjoy the experience — have fun!

[b]🔥New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] New mode: Speedruns.
[*] Live leaderboards for player performance.
[*] Display of personal and global height climbed.
[*] More graphic resolution options.
[/list]
[b]💠Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Major overall optimization work.
[*] Significant improvements to translations.
[*] Lobby has been reworked and improved.
[*] Camera now automatically faces the credits when they appear.
[*] Added meshes under jumpers in the Space and Fantasy worlds.
[*] Added ceiling collisions in the tower.
[*] Message to return to the lobby now appears later during the credits.
[*] Increased delay between platforms in the Space area.
[*] Fan collisions have been refined for better precision.
[*] Fan forces rebalanced.
[*] Evolution tutorial progression slowed down for clarity.
[*] Scanner audio is disabled when holding the key.
[*] Grab collisions disabled on moving objects.
[*] Evolution system tutorial redesigned for better clarity.
[*] Character now rotates correctly after using a teleporter.
[*] Improved indication for the tutorial room at the start of the game.
[*] Added explanation for describing events.
[*] Added text to indicate where events and challenges are located.
[*] Tutorial intro is skipped automatically if the player exits during character creation.
[*] Player stuck inside the gear is now teleported above it.
[*] Consumable durations rebalanced.
[/list]
[b]⚙️Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Graphics settings now save properly.
[*] Teleporter no longer breaks the screen display (tilted screen bug fixed).
[*] Fixed a bug where music wouldn’t return when going back to the lab.
[*] Fixed scanner text shortcuts not appearing.
[/list]
I can't wait to read your feedback! Stay tuned for upcoming updates.
Join the community and share your thoughts: [url=https://bento.me/anotherslimestudio]Another Slime Studio[/url]

Thanks and see you soon! 🚀
Artékuro.

notes.title: ASCENDARIA - Update 0.7.2

notes.title: Ascendaria is released!
notes.content:
Are you ready to take on the challenge and climb to the top. 
It's finally time to explore this world and push your limits.

Ascendaria is now available for purchase!

Key Features
🚀 Free Climbing: Ascend higher and higher by mastering your environment.
🔧 Dynamic Evolution: Improve your abilities based on your actions.
🛠 Tools & Consumables: Use jetpacks, gliders, and other gear to overcome obstacles.
🎭 Uncover Mysteries: Progress and uncover the secrets of the simulation.
🤖 A Unique Guide: The AI S.L.I.M.E. will assist you with insightful advice… and some sharp wit.

🎥 Watch the launch trailer

We look forward to your feedback.
Contact us here: [url=https://bento.me/anotherslimestudio]Another Slime Studio[/url]
Stay tuned for more information.

Thank you and see you soon!

notes.title: Beta Tests - Update 0.4.0
notes.content:
[b]New features[/b]
🔥The laboratory has been set up and will serve as a hub.
> New tutorials for the game's various skills and consumables.
> A voice representing an AI that will guide and accompany us.
> Collection room where you'll find your various discoveries from the adventure.
🔥New events will be set up to give you a temporary bonus at your peril.
🔥Add new challenges for each level to get a permanent bonus.
🔥New skills are available such as dash and scanner.
🔥Everything is now constantly saved in-game, you can return to the lab and resume your ascencion at any time without risk.
🔥Various functions are available in the lab to restart your ascencion by choosing what you want to keep from your previous ascencion.
🔥The ‘jail’ part of the game is now much bigger and more interesting.
🔥The evolution system is now possible in automatic or manual mode.
🔥New music has been added depending on where you are.

[b]Changes[/b]
💠No more main menu, everything is available directly in the in-game lab.
💠Different collisions have been corrected to simplify ascencion.
💠 The skill for catching up with the environment has been reworked and improved.
💠 The layout of skills has been revised in the various levels.

[b]Fixes[/b]
⚙️Les sound options now work correctly.
⚙️Toutes skills and their displays have been fixed.

We look forward to your feedback.
Stay tuned for more information.

Thank you and see you soon!

notes.title: Beta-Tests - Update 0.1.1
notes.content:
[b]New[/b]

🔥New graphic elements in the desert area

💠 Random consumables now reappear after 30 seconds

We look forward to your feedback.
Stay tuned for more information.

Thanks and see you soon!
